subject: Quick deadline question
text: Hi there, could you confirm the deadline for the project file? I know priorities changed after the client call, and I'm trying not to miss anything. Should the revised schedule still finish by next Tuesday, or are we now pushing to the end of the month? I only need a quick yes or no on the key dates so I can adjust my work. If the new priorities affect the handoff, tell me now before I start. No need for long explanation, just essential dates please.
